system.description:
By Coating your weapon in Chakra, and creating an extremely powerful spin you sharpen the edge just enough to split the air and even sound. Make a Ranged taijutsu attack, dealing [Weapon Damage] + 3d4 on a hit.

Chain 1: On a hit, the affected creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of their next turn, for every 5 feet they move, they take 1d6 slashing damage as razor thin wire slices into them.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 2d4
